args.subject: My HIIT workout last night — quick update
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to share a quick update about the HIIT class I did last night. I went with my colleague Alex to the new fitness center downtown. The session was intense — we pushed through circuit rounds of burpees, squats, and sprints. I felt really energized afterward; it was a great way to shake up my usual routine.

Just thought you’d like to hear! Let me know if you want to try a class together sometime.

Cheers,

args.subject: Positive feedback on this morning's yoga class
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to share some positive feedback about the new yoga class I tried this morning. The instructor, Rachel, led a relaxing flow that really helped me unwind after a hectic week. I loved the calming atmosphere and the soothing music she played during the practice. It was a wonderful session — I’ll definitely go back.

Thanks,

args.subject: Tried a recipe from "The Italian Kitchen: Pasta Perfection"
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I tried a dish from "The Italian Kitchen: Pasta Perfection" — a classic carbonara. It had a creamy egg sauce, crispy pancetta, and a sprinkle of freshly cracked black pepper. It turned out delicious and I can't wait to make it again for friends.

Would you like me to send you the recipe or bring some the next time we meet?

Cheers,

args.subject: Cooking class last night — homemade pasta & Bolognese
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to share what I learned at a cooking class last night. We made homemade pasta from scratch and a rich, flavorful Bolognese sauce. The chef, Maria, shared some great tips for perfecting the pasta dough texture (focus on kneading and letting the dough rest), and the final dish turned out delicious.

If you’d like, I can send the recipe or we can plan a time to make it together.

Best,

args.subject: Brunch with Sarah — Elm Street
args.body:
Hi Iris,

Just wanted to share that I met my childhood friend Sarah for brunch yesterday at the cozy cafe on Elm Street. We caught up over avocado toast and lattes — it was lovely.

Best,
